description: M/ Investment Promotion - The Colombo port city economic commission Act, No. 11 of 2021.Gateway International Campus (PVT) LTD
categorisation: This gazette notification designates a specific company (GATEWAY INTERNATIONAL CAMPUS (PRIVATE) LIMITED) as a "Primary Business of Strategic Importance" under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act. It details business registration information, licensing details, investment amounts, and commercial incentives/exemptions granted to the company. The content focuses on business/commercial matters rather than government personnel/structure, land ownership, legal frameworks, or other specialized categories, making it a Commercial Gazette (Type 6).
